address: 25 Hoang Sa Street, Sai Gon Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 71007, Vietnam
bio: Each bowl of phở is prepared with the utmost care. The herb garnishes are carefully trimmed and cleaned for ultimate freshness. The house special is a selection of beef cuts. The standout is the oxtail, which is braised for 40 hours until tender and has a delightfully gelatinous finish....
